divisions.name: CDMO - small molecules

divisions.name: CDMO - Bio (Laurus Bio)

divisions.name: Affordable Medicines - API

divisions.name: Affordable Medicines - FDF

accounting.item: EBITDA definitions differ: the company's EBITDA (Rs1,826 cr FY26) includes other income (forex gains, misc income; FY25 also the Rs59 cr land-sale gain); Screener's (Rs1,785 cr) excludes other income but adds back the Rs7.5 cr loss on sale of PPE. We use Screener's basis throughout.
FY25 one-off: Rs58.85 cr profit on sale of land at MN Park, Hyderabad to the KRKA joint venture (company: Rs0.9 EPS); Screener books Rs57 cr pre-tax / Rs39 cr after tax as exceptional.
Customer advances: Rs644.6 cr at Mar-26 (Rs395.2 cr Mar-25); none received in Q1FY27. They fund capacity and flatter operating cash flow.
Allowance for bad and doubtful advances and debts Rs80.8 cr in FY26 (Rs53.4 cr FY25), inside other expenses.
R&D on advanced biologics partly capitalised: Q1FY27 R&D Rs118 cr included Rs35 cr of capex R&D; management says some ADC/gene-therapy spend is expensed, not capitalised.
Corporate guarantees for subsidiaries' borrowings earn guarantee commission; land and PPE pledged as security for term loans.

underlyingEps._why: Reported EPS less exceptional items after tax per share (Screener 'Exceptional items AT' / implied shares): FY25 -Rs39 cr (land sale gain), FY26 +Rs6 cr (loss on PPE sale), others Rs0-1 cr.
